attempted_claim: Does there exist a Hamiltonian-displaceable monotone embedded Lagrangian torus L in a closed monotone toric (Fano) symplectic manifold such that, with e(L) the displacement energy and hbar(L) Chekanov's minimal-area quantity, 0 < hbar(L) < e(L) < infinity?
decisive_failure: Investigation was bounded to literature-grounded routes: toric-fiber dichotomy, small Chekanov tori in CP^n via optimized-curve bounds, and exotic monotone families. A full resolution of the strict-gap question in closed monotone toric Fano manifolds remains open at the level of Yaar Questions 3-4 and would require either a new uniform Floer-theoretic rigidity theorem or a fundamentally new exotic displaceable-monotone torus, both beyond this lane.
